title: Solar Water Pumping for Aquaculture — Kayunga District
summary: Solar-powered water circulation systems for 3 fish ponds improving water quality and fish yields for aquaculture farmers in Kayunga District, Central Uganda.
description: Aquaculture in Kayunga District is constrained by poor water quality in seasonal fish ponds and inadequate aeration for intensive production. This project installed solar-powered water circulation and aeration systems at 3 aquaculture sites operated by fish farmer cooperatives. The systems include submersible circulation pumps, paddle-wheel aerators, and water quality sensors with remote monitoring. Fish yields at pilot sites increased by 35% in the first production cycle compared to control ponds. Training of fish farmers covered system operation, water quality management, feed rationing, and record keeping.
fundingPartner: World Bank — Uganda Agri-Business Development Project
outcomes: 3 aquaculture sites with solar aeration; 35% fish yield increase; water quality sensors installed; 180 fish farmers with improved production.
